items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: I think Barney Bigard does that.

ctx.x: Well, my father taught me that way. I had to start that way. Do you still do that? No, I don't. You don't do that now? No. And after I got able to play some, he said, well, you don't have to cover each other teeth anymore.
Mm-hmm. Very few people do it. I think Barney Bigard does that.
